index.title: Tools
index.subtitle: One-off actions for this server: mention lists, roles, threads, cleaning up messages and lookups.

mention.name: Mention lists
mention.description: List who reacted to a message, or who did not, ready to paste or post.

roleAssign.name: Assign roles
roleAssign.description: Give or take a role for many members at once.

threads.name: Threads
threads.description: Open threads, open private threads for members, and rename or delete threads by prefix.

purge.name: Delete messages
purge.description: Delete the newest messages of a channel, or every message between two.

activity.name: New activity
activity.description: Create the roles and channels of an activity.

attendance.name: Voice attendance
attendance.description: See who of a role is in a voice channel right now.

info.name: Lookups
info.description: A member introduction, who reacted, who holds a role, and invite links.
